summary: Build GDPR compliance skills with Article 30, DPIA, SAR, and breach response training. Learn practical privacy controls and reporting.
lede: GDPR compliance training gives privacy, legal, security and governance professionals practical methods for documenting processing, risk decisions and controls. Participants practice mapping personal data flows, maintaining Article 30 records, assessing lawful bases, and handling data subject requests and breach response. The course also covers DPIAs, vendor oversight, data transfers and compliance reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already handle data, compliance, legal review, security, or governance and need to apply GDPR requirements in day-to-day operations.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, bring a laptop, a spreadsheet application, and a willingness to work with sample privacy artefacts such as processing logs, vendor lists, or incident records. Familiarity with your organisation's data flows, policies, or compliance workflow will help you complete the hands-on exercises more quickly.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
